entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One C57BL/6J mouse. The data descriptor: the slices of a day come 'from the same animal', and the recordings are 'from seven hippocampal CA1 pyramidal cells of two 6-months old C57Bl/6J mice, recorded on 2 different days'. The animal is identified by the recording date, as in the EBRAINS Knowledge Graph (internalIdentifier 170518 and 170529).

entityTypes.name: cell
entityTypes.description: One whole-cell patched CA1 pyramidal neuron. The data descriptor: 'The digits represent the date when the data was recorded (year month day) and the number of the slice recorded on that day from the same animal.' One neuron was recorded per slice; 7 cells in total.

entityTypes.name: recording
entityTypes.description: One ABF file: one repetition of the excitability protocol (0-450 pA in 50 pA steps, 500 ms) for a cell. The data descriptor: 'The letters a-e signify the excitability protocol repeated 5-times for a single neuron.'

dataLocations.description: Garad and Lessmann, excitability of mouse hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons during sustained strong depolarization (dataset version 07554ebd-95a2-46f0-8065-d961d56ce098). A flat folder of Axon Binary Format files named <yyMMdd>_<slice><repeat>.ABF, with the data descriptor and licence PDFs. The descriptor lists the files as <yyMMdd>_<slice>a-e.abf; the files in the bucket end in .ABF. Every entry of the bucket was listed.
